title: RecordingHeader
description: Line 1 of every recording and the first frame of the Stage 3 live stream. Position, not a type field, distinguishes it from state lines.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version. Authoritative for the recording or stream; every state line must match it. Version 1 requires the player attribution, seat partition, and materialized seat plan because pre-release recordings are recreated rather than supported.

environment.description: Name of the environment that produced this recording.

parameters.description: Complete resolved environment parameter map used by this episode.

seed.description: Episode seed. Optional now; filled in by Stage 2.

sidecars.description: Auxiliary files stored alongside the recording. A reader that does not recognize a name must skip that entry and load the recording normally.

name.description: Identifies the sidecar's kind against the registry of known names (empty in Stage 1).

path.description: Path relative to the recording's own directory.

players.description: Per-player attribution: who or what drove each PettingZoo player this episode, keyed by player id (as in a step state's agents map).

submission_id.description: The submission whose code ran this player.

builtin_name.description: Stable name of the built-in agent whose code ran this player.

seats.description: The resolved seat-to-player map, keyed by seat id. Together with players this is an exact player partition.

seat_plan.description: Canonical key of the resolved seat plan, or solo for a player-bounds environment.
